generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Square Christmas advent-calendar sampler, a dense joyful quilt of EXACTLY FIVE columns and FIVE rows of equal-sized miniature pixel-art pictures, 25 pictures total. The complete artwork will be reduced to 45x45 pixels; EACH individual picture must therefore be designed as a very simple 9x9-pixel sprite. Every day must be a satisfying little picture independently. Each picture stays entirely within its own exact one-fifth-width by one-fifth-height block. Blocks fill the canvas edge to edge, NO outside margins, NO gutters, NO dividing lines. Each motif occupies about 7x7 of its 9x9 block with a one-pixel breathing space. Use chunky single-colour squares and very simple silhouettes, no subpixel details. Render at a large square resolution but with the visual simplicity of true 45x45 pixel art. Make each block use at least four clearly distinct colours, each colour in meaningful clusters, not scattered noise. Background at most half of each block. Alternate rich blue, green, pink, red and white backgrounds for a cohesive festive patchwork. Foreground must contrast strongly with its local background. No large empty sky or ground.
Row 1, left to right: red gift with yellow ribbon; green Christmas tree with yellow star and red ornaments; white snowman with red scarf; red stocking with white cuff and green gift; yellow ringing bell with red bow.
Row 2: red-and-white candy cane with green bow; white candle with orange flame in green holder; green wreath with red bow; brown gingerbread person with white icing and red buttons; red round bauble with yellow cap and white stripe.
Row 3: red Santa hat with white trim; red snowy house with yellow window; gold star on blue with green sprigs; brown reindeer face with red nose; green mitten with white cuff and pink decoration.
Row 4: blue-and-white snowflake with yellow centre; yellow wrapped present with red ribbon; white mug with red heart and brown hot cocoa; green holly leaves with red berries; red toy train with black wheels and yellow window.
Row 5: white-and-red striped sweet; green Christmas tree in brown pot with pink ornaments; red lantern with yellow light; blue bauble with yellow cap and white stripe; white angel with yellow halo and pink robe.
Prioritise unmistakable simplified icon silhouettes at NINE pixels wide; avoid intricate illustration, lettering, numbers, texture, gradients, antialiasing, perspective, borders and grid strokes. One coherent flat festive sampler, not a photograph of a calendar. Palette guide: White #FFFFFF, Black #07111B, Blue #01004E, Light blue #005EA3, Green #004417, Lime green #568A00, Yellow #B09100, Orange #B54600, Red #7B010D, Pink #AC436C, Purple #060145, Grey #2E3436, Brown #2D1912.
